const cmds = [
  {
    cmd: `python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.lint import AT_TOKEN_RE,MARKUP_RE
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root=Path('.'); task=root/'.ai/task/repair-w34-20260926'
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
base=subprocess.run(['git','show','HEAD:tome-cults.lua'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
before=loader.load_bytes(base,logical_path='tome-cults.lua').records
after=loader.load_path(root/'tome-cults.lua',logical_path='tome-cults.lua').records
work=json.loads((task/'WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
allowed={(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag']):x for x in work}
conv=r'%[-+#0]*[0-9]*(?:\\.[0-9]+)?[diouxXeEfFgGcsq]'
ph=re.compile(rf'(?:{conv}%%)|(?:{conv})|%%')
tpl=re.compile(r'<\\?=.*?\\?>',re.S)
def nl(r): return {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='line'}
def tabs(line): return len(line)-len(line.lstrip('\\t'))
assert len(before)==len(after)
changed=[]
for b,a in zip(before,after):
  if nl(b)==nl(a): continue
  key=(b.get('section'),b.get('source'),b.get('source_tag'))
  assert key in allowed,('out_of_scope',key)
  item=allowed[key]; rev=item['entry_revision_identity']
  assert b['target']==item['target_preimage'],rev
  assert {k:v for k,v in nl(b).items() if k!='target'}=={k:v for k,v in nl(a).items() if k!='target'},('non_target',rev)
  assert ph.findall(a['source'])==ph.findall(a['target']),('placeholder',rev)
  assert MARKUP_RE.findall(a['source'])==MARKUP_RE.findall(a['target']),('markup',rev)
  assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(a['source'])==AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(a['target']),('at_token',rev)
  assert tpl.findall(a['source'])==tpl.findall(a['target']),('template',rev)
  sl=a['source'].split('\\n'); tl=a['target'].split('\\n'); bl=b['target'].split('\\n')
  assert len(sl)==len(tl),('lf',rev)
  assert [i for i,x in enumerate(sl) if x.strip()=='']==[i for i,x in enumerate(tl) if x.strip()==''],('blank_indices',rev)
  for i,(s,t) in enumerate(zip(sl,tl)):
    if s.strip(): assert tabs(s)==tabs(t),('tabs',rev,i,tabs(s),tabs(t))
    if t.endswith('\\t'): assert i<len(bl) and bl[i].endswith('\\t'),('new_target_trailing_tab',rev,i)
  assert a['source'].endswith('\\n')==a['target'].endswith('\\n'),('terminal_lf',rev)
  changed.append(rev)
assert len(changed)==29,('changed_count',len(changed))
assert set(changed)=={x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in work},'workset mismatch'
print(json.dumps({'verified':True,'baseline':'HEAD','records_before':len(before),'records_after':len(after),'changed_target_count':len(changed),'out_of_workset_changes':0,'structure_checks':29},ensure_ascii=False))
PY`,
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 5000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行用户要求的 LuaJIT 有界记录验证吗？"
  },
  {
    cmd: "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict",
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 5000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行用户要求的严格翻译 lint 吗？"
  },
  {
    cmd: "git diff --check",
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 5000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行用户要求的 Git 空白差异检查吗？"
  }
];
const results = await Promise.all(cmds.map(c => tools.exec_command(c)));
results.forEach((r,i)=>text(JSON.stringify({check:i+1,exit_code:r.exit_code,output:r.output})));
